schema: SLeeLa FRUCHST frequency candidate staging v1

source.code_license: MIT (not the license for extracted data)
attribution: Wiktionary contributors via Kaikki/Wiktextract (CC BY-SA 4.0; upstream dataset attribution)
source.selection: First 1,000 unique NFC-normalized lemmas encountered in source frequency_rank order from the upstream top-2,000 preview. Duplicate lemmas across POS rows are collapsed to their highest-frequency row; original source_rank and frequency_count are retained.
caveats: Frequency-candidate staging only; not a completed FRUCHST dictionary.
OpenSubtitles-derived rankings are subtitle-domain rankings, not a balanced general-purpose corpus.
Counts are corpus occurrences, not normalized per million; do not compare raw counts across languages.
Three definitions (English, French, Spanish) are not yet supplied; no binary should be generated from this staging data.
